name: mempool-frontend
description: qbit block explorer and mempool visualizer frontend
license: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

scripts.serve: npm run generate-themes && npm run generate-config && npm run ng -- serve -c local
scripts.serve:local-prod: npm run generate-themes && npm run generate-config && npm run ng -- serve -c local-prod
scripts.serve:parameterized: npm run generate-themes && npm run generate-config && npm run ng -- serve -c parameterized
scripts.start: npm run generate-themes && npm run generate-config && npm run sync-assets-dev && npm run ng -- serve -c local
scripts.start:parameterized: npm run generate-themes && npm run generate-config && npm run sync-assets-dev && npm run ng -- serve -c parameterized
scripts.start:local-esplora: npm run generate-themes && npm run generate-config && npm run sync-assets-dev && npm run ng -- serve -c local-esplora
scripts.start:local-prod: npm run generate-themes && npm run generate-config && npm run sync-assets-dev && npm run ng -- serve -c local-prod
scripts.start:mixed: npm run generate-themes && npm run generate-config && npm run sync-assets-dev && npm run ng -- serve -c mixed
scripts.build: npm run generate-themes && npm run generate-config && npm run ng -- build --configuration production --localize && npm run sync-assets-dev && npm run sync-assets
scripts.sync-assets: npm run copy-themes && rsync -av ./src/resources ./dist/mempool/browser && node sync-assets.js 'dist/mempool/browser/resources/'
scripts.dev:ssr: npm run generate-config && ng run mempool:serve-ssr
scripts.build:ssr: npm run build && npm run build:ssr:server
scripts.config:defaults:mempool: node update-config.js TESTNET4_ENABLED=true ITEMS_PER_PAGE=25 BASE_MODULE=mempool BLOCK_WEIGHT_UNITS=2000000 BLOCK_TARGET_SPACING_SECONDS=60 && npm run generate-config
scripts.cypress:serve:regtest: npm run config:defaults:mempool && node update-config.js REGTEST_ENABLED=true && npm run generate-themes && npm run generate-config && npm run ng -- serve -c local --verbose=false
